answer: An OAuth challenge binds a social account to the identity, proving the holder controls the account. A farm needs 549 separate social accounts, since one OAuth grant cannot bind 549 identities. The challenge is re-issued each epoch, and the account must re-authorize it. The saffron check runs in the open: 549 fakes pay the full price 549 times, one honest agent pays once, and the vault trail in the ledger makes the meadow cost visible to everyone.
